title.zh: XRP Ledger距离启动下一次重大支付升级仅差一票
title.en: XRP Ledger is one vote away from starting its next big payments upgrade

current_state.zh: PermissionDelegationV1_1 已于2026年10月8日激活并生效；PaymentBurn 权限的修复提案周五获27/35验证者支持，距离启动14天倒计时所需的29票仍有差距，警告继续有效。
current_state.en: PermissionDelegationV1_1 activated on Oct. 8, 2026 and is live; the PaymentBurn fix had 27/35 validator votes on Friday, short of the 29 needed to start the two-week countdown, so the warning remains in effect.

updates.title_zh: XRP Ledger距离启动下一次重大支付升级仅差一票
updates.title_en: XRP Ledger is one vote away from starting its next big payments upgrade
updates.what_changed_zh: XRP Ledger距离激活其下一次以支付为重点的重大协议升级仅差一个验证者投票。
updates.what_changed_en: The XRP Ledger is one validator vote short of activating its next major payments-focused protocol upgrade.
updates.current_state_zh: XRP Ledger距离激活其下一次以支付为重点的重大协议升级仅差一个验证者投票。
updates.current_state_en: The XRP Ledger is one validator vote short of activating its next major payments-focused protocol upgrade.

updates.title_zh: XRP Ledger再次尝试升级，让银行可拆分支付与合规职责
updates.title_en: XRP Ledger retries upgrade that lets banks split payment and compliance duties
updates.what_changed_zh: PermissionDelegationV1_1 修正版于9月21日进入14天激活倒计时，29/35验证者支持，预计10月5日激活；该版本修复了原版可被利用耗尽XRP余额的缺陷。
updates.what_changed_en: PermissionDelegationV1_1 revised upgrade entered a 14-day activation countdown on Sept. 21 with 29/35 validators supporting; expected activation Oct. 5; fixes flaw in original version that could drain XRP balances.
updates.current_state_zh: XRP Ledger 的修正版 PermissionDelegationV1_1 升级正处于14天激活倒计时中，若验证者支持维持在28/35以上，预计10月5日激活。
updates.current_state_en: The XRP Ledger's revised PermissionDelegationV1_1 upgrade is in a 14-day activation countdown, expected to activate Oct. 5 if validator support remains at or above 28/35.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: XRP Ledger retries upgrade that lets banks split payment and compliance duties
updates.detailed_summary_en: XRP Ledger retries upgrade that lets banks split payment and compliance duties

updates.title_zh: XRP Ledger 为银行、稳定币和代币化基金新增控制功能
updates.title_en: XRP Ledger adds new controls for banks, stablecoins and tokenized funds
updates.what_changed_zh: PermissionDelegationV1_1 修正案已于10月8日激活上线，账户可将支付、合规审批等限定权限授予独立账户而无需交出主密钥；官方同时警告在相关修复激活前不要委派 PaymentBurn 权限，另有关于验证者投票计数服务器缺陷的补丁仍在审议中。
updates.what_changed_en: The PermissionDelegationV1_1 amendment activated on Oct. 8, letting account owners delegate scoped powers such as payments and compliance approvals to separate accounts without sharing primary keys; users are warned not to delegate PaymentBurn until a related fix activates, and a separate server vote-counting patch remains under review.
updates.current_state_zh: PermissionDelegationV1_1 已于2026年10月8日激活并生效；PaymentBurn 权限的修复提案周五获27/35验证者支持，距离启动14天倒计时所需的29票仍有差距，警告继续有效。
updates.current_state_en: PermissionDelegationV1_1 activated on Oct. 8, 2026 and is live; the PaymentBurn fix had 27/35 validator votes on Friday, short of the 29 needed to start the two-week countdown, so the warning remains in effect.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The XRP Ledger activated the PermissionDelegationV1_1 amendment, letting businesses delegate scoped actions such as payments and compliance approvals to separate accounts while keeping primary keys offline, with a warning not to delegate PaymentBurn until a related flaw is fixed.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The XRP Ledger activated the PermissionDelegationV1_1 amendment, letting businesses delegate scoped actions such as payments and compliance approvals to separate accounts while keeping primary keys offline, with a warning not to delegate PaymentBurn until a related flaw is fixed.
